description_en: Creates an automatic snapshot policy that schedules snapshots for WUYING Workspace based on a cron expression
description_zh: 创建自动快照策略，让云电脑按照Cron表达式对应的时间自动创建快照
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-name test_auto_policy --retention-days 2 --cron-expression 0_0_2_0_0_1-7 --disk-type example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to get a list of regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. It can contain 2 to 128 English or Chinese characters. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略的名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。默认值：空
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en: The retention period of the automatic snapshot, in days. Valid values: 1 to 180
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：1\~180
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en: The cron expression for the recurring schedule
parameters.help_zh: 时间周期调度的Cron表达式
parameters.name: cron_expression
